lines.text: Wait! Why You Hear ZERO Sound Inside Outer Space!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why is space silent!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Sound travels as vibrations bumping through air molecules.
because outer space is mostly an.
empty vacuum, sound waves cannot travel there.
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Silent Space!
